items.pattern: is said to + base for an earlier action
items.sk: Dej bol skôr, preto perfect Infinitive: „{right}“, nie „{wrong}“.
items.cz: Děj byl dříve, proto perfect Infinitive: „{right}“, ne „{wrong}“.
items.en: The action was earlier, so the perfect Infinitive: “{right}”, not “{wrong}”.

items.pattern: is said to have + participle for something true now
items.sk: Platí to teraz, preto jednoduchý Infinitive: „{right}“, nie „{wrong}“.
items.cz: Platí to teď, proto prostý Infinitive: „{right}“, ne „{wrong}“.
items.en: It is true now, so the simple Infinitive: “{right}”, not “{wrong}”.

items.pattern: subject + is said + that-clause (mixing personal and impersonal passive)
items.sk: Po podmete s „is said“ nasleduje Infinitive, nie „that“: „{right}“.
items.cz: Po podmětu s „is said“ následuje Infinitive, ne „that“: „{right}“.
items.en: After a subject + “is said” use the Infinitive, not “that”: “{right}”.

items.pattern: People say / They say + clause instead of the passive
items.en: Practise the Passive here: “{right}”.

items.pattern: is supposed to / is believed to instead of the practised is said to
items.en: Practise the Passive with “say”: “{right}”.

items.pattern: to have + Past Simple form (to have took)
items.sk: Po „to have“ patrí past participle: „{right}“, nie „{wrong}“.
items.cz: Po „to have“ následuje past participle: „{right}“, ne „{wrong}“.
items.en: After “to have” use the past participle: “{right}”, not “{wrong}”.

items.pattern: to have + base form
items.en: After “to have” use the past participle: “{right}”.

items.pattern: is said + -ing
items.en: After “is said” use the Infinitive: “{right}”, not “{wrong}”.

items.pattern: is said + base form without to
items.en: After “is said” use “to” + verb: “{right}”.

items.pattern: It says (that) … for 'hovorí sa'
items.sk: „It says“ znamená, že je to niekde napísané. Treba Passive: „{right}“.
items.cz: „It says“ znamená, že je to někde napsané. Je potřeba Passive: „{right}“.
items.en: “It says” means it is written somewhere. Use the Passive: “{right}”.

items.pattern: About X is said (that) … word-for-word from 'o … sa hovorí'
items.cz: Doslovné „About … is said“ nefunguje; je potřeba „{right}“.
items.en: A word-for-word “About … is said” does not work; use “{right}”.

items.pattern: Is said that … without It
items.en: The subject “It” is missing: “It is said that…”.

items.kind: active form with thing as subject
items.pattern: thing + says/believes (This mascara says to …)
items.cz: Věc nic neříká; je potřeba Passive: „{right}“.
items.en: The thing says nothing itself; use the Passive: “{right}”.

items.pattern: passive without a form of be (The treaty said to …)
items.en: The Passive needs a form of “be”: “{right}”, not “{wrong}”.

items.pattern: was said / has been said instead of present is said
items.en: The reporting verb is present here: “{right}”, not “{wrong}”.

items.pattern: passive + by people / by everyone
items.en: “by people” is unnecessary; just “{right}”.

items.kind: active Gerund instead of passive Gerund
items.pattern: verb + -ing where being + participle is needed (likes rushing)
items.sk: Podmet dej nerobí, ale znáša: passive Gerund „{right}“, nie „{wrong}“.
items.cz: Podmět děj nedělá, ale snáší: passive Gerund „{right}“, ne „{wrong}“.
items.en: The subject receives the action: passive Gerund “{right}”, not “{wrong}”.

items.pattern: verb + been + participle instead of being + participle
items.en: The passive Gerund is “being” + past participle: “{right}”.

items.pattern: is + participle for an action in progress (is repaired now)
items.sk: Dej práve prebieha: Passive Continuous „{right}“, nie „{wrong}“.
items.cz: Děj právě probíhá: Passive Continuous „{right}“, ne „{wrong}“.
items.en: It is happening now: Passive Continuous “{right}”, not “{wrong}”.

items.pattern: irregular verb with a regular -ed participle in the passive
items.sk: Nepravidelné sloveso: past participle je „{right}“, nie „{wrong}“.
items.cz: Nepravidelné sloveso: past participle je „{right}“, ne „{wrong}“.
items.en: Irregular verb: the past participle is “{right}”, not “{wrong}”.

items.pattern: take + time + for + -ing instead of to + verb
items.en: After “take + time” use the Infinitive: “{right}”.
